# KXBYTE

> KXBYTE is a business technology company building connected software products for modern businesses. Products include KxTill (retail point of sale), KxWork (workforce and tasks), KxCRM (customer management), KxInvoice (invoicing), and KxPay (payments) — all connected through KXBYTE Suite.

## Products

- [KxTill](https://kxbyte.co.ke/products/kxtill): Offline-first point-of-sale system for growing retail businesses. Sales, stock, customers, payments, and multi-branch operations. Works without internet. Live.
- [KXBYTE Suite](https://suite.kxbyte.co.ke): The organizational layer connecting products, people, permissions, branches, and billing in one account. Live.
- [KxWork](https://kxbyte.co.ke/products/kxwork): Workforce and task management. In development.
- [KxCRM](https://kxbyte.co.ke/products/kxcrm): Customer relationship management. In development.
- [KxInvoice](https://kxbyte.co.ke/products/kxinvoice): Invoicing connected to sales. In development.
- [KxPay](https://kxbyte.co.ke/products/kxpay): Payment reconciliation. In development.
